##  Bird Sightings at Sea


# Data Cleaning

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(lubridate)

# Load data
birds <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-04-14/birds.csv')
ships <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-04-14/ships.csv')

# Join + clean
data <- birds %>%
  left_join(ships, by = "record_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude), !is.na(species_common_name)) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    count = ifelse(count == 99999, 100000, count)
  )

# Top species for clarity
top_species <- data %>%
  count(species_common_name, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 8) %>%
  pull(species_common_name)

data_filtered <- data %>%
  filter(species_common_name %in% top_species)

```

```{r fig.width=10}
# Base plot
original_plot <- ggplot(data_filtered, aes(
  x = longitude,
  y = latitude,
  size = count,
  color = species_common_name,
  frame = year,  
  text = paste0(
    "<b>Species:</b> ", species_common_name,
    "<br><b>Count:</b> ", count,
    "<br><b>Year:</b> ", year,
    "<br><b>Activity:</b> ", activity,
    "<br><b>Feeding:</b> ", feeding
  )
)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 12)) +
  labs(
    title = "Bird Sightings at Sea (1969–1990)",
    subtitle = "Tracking seabird observations across time and space near New Zealand\nTop species shown • Point size reflects flock size • Animation shows temporal patterns",
    caption = "TidyTuesday 2026 Week 15 | Source: Te Papa Tongarewa (Museum of New Zealand)\nEach point represents a 10-minute ship-based observation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11)
  )

original_plot

```

```{r}
# Base plot
plotly_plot <- ggplot(data_filtered, aes(
  x = longitude,
  y = latitude,
  size = count,
  color = species_common_name,
  frame = year,  
  text = paste0(
    "<b>Species:</b> ", species_common_name,
    "<br><b>Count:</b> ", count,
    "<br><b>Year:</b> ", year,
    "<br><b>Activity:</b> ", activity,
    "<br><b>Feeding:</b> ", feeding
  )
)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size(range = c(1, 12)) +
  labs(
    title = "Bird Sightings at Sea (1969–1990)\n Source: Te Papa Tongarewa (Museum of New Zealand) \n Author: William Acosta Lora ",
    subtitle = "Tracking seabird observations across time and space near New Zealand\nTop species shown • Point size reflects flock size • Animation shows temporal patterns",
    caption = "TidyTuesday 2026 Week 15 | Source: Te Papa Tongarewa (Museum of New Zealand)\nEach point represents a 10-minute ship-based observation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11)
  )

plotly_plot
```

```{r}
# Make the original plot interactive using plotly
ggplotly(original_plot, tooltip = "text") %>%
  animation_opts(frame = 800, easing = "linear", redraw = FALSE) %>%
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: "))
```
 **Trend: The visualization reveals a spike in sightings during the late 1980s, specifically concentrated around the $160^\circ$ longitude mark. While early years (1970s) show sparse data, the period between 1986–1990 shows a high density of Wandering Albatross observations.**
